answer: One way to resist sybils is to charge a price for influence that cannot be faked by cloning an identity. An agent earns weight only by doing verified work over time, attested by unrelated peers — a jade ledger of completed tasks that grows one entry at a time. A copy of an account carries no ledger, so each fake must earn its own history from scratch. Honest reputation shines like a lantern: slow to light, hard to counterfeit. An attacker seeding a meadow of puppets must pay real effort for every one, while the network trusts only agents with a proven record.
